title: Widow's Bight Civic Reel — Official History, 1923

frames.caption: THE FLEET
frames.body: In living memory the fishing fleet of Widow's Bight put out under fair weather and did not return. The official account records a spring squall. The insurance account records a navigational error. The parish account records the intercession of Providence. No two of these agree on the hour.

frames.caption: THE MONEY
frames.body: Settlement of the claims rebuilt the quay, the club, and half the street that faces the water. The town does not discuss the source of the funds with strangers. It does not discuss them with residents either, except in the register of deeds.

frames.caption: NO BLOODLINE
frames.body: There is no founding family. There is no hereditary claim. There is only the town, and the work it does to remain itself. What the fleet took with it is not spoken of as inheritance.

frames.caption: TONIGHT
frames.body: Six men in evening dress. A rose garden. A report that will want a simpler shape than the bodies allow.
